body.title: Christmas Cookie Exchange Kit Printable, Cookie Swap Invitation, Sign Up Sheet, Allergen Cookie Labels, Recipe Cards, Voting Ballots
body.description:
Host a Christmas cookie swap without the guesswork: guests sign up so nobody bakes the same cookie, the baking math table tells everyone exactly how many to bring for 6 to 15 guests, every plate gets a label with allergen checkboxes, and ballots crown the best cookie.

What's inside (13 pages):
- How to host in six steps
- Fill-in invitations, 2 per page
- Host countdown from 3 weeks out to the day after
- Guest sign-up sheet with dozens and allergen columns
- Swap rules, packing list and a baking math table for 6 to 15 guests
- Recipe cards, 4 per page
- Cookie labels with allergen checkboxes (nuts, peanuts, dairy, eggs, gluten, soy), 8 per page
- Best Cookie ballots in four categories, 8 per page
- Voting tally sheet and 4 cookie award cards
- Thank-you cards, 4 per page
- Take-home box tags, 12 per page
- Recipe swap list

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home on cardstock and cut along the card edges. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". For personal use.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.

body.title: Gingerbread House Decorating Contest Printable, Judge Score Cards, Voting Ballots and Award Certificates for Kids, Teens and Adults
body.description:
Run a gingerbread house contest that feels fair and fun: judges score every house on five criteria, guests vote People's Choice, and kids, teens and adults each get their own winners.

What's inside (15 pages):
- How to Run Your Contest: six steps plus the three age divisions
- Host Plan, supply checklist and party timeline
- Official Contest Rules (10 rules) with space for your house rules
- Team Sign-Up Sheet (14 teams)
- Team Build Plan with a sketch box and job list
- Judge Score Cards, 2 per page: Creativity, Structure, Decoration Detail, Neat Icing and Wow Factor, each scored 1 to 5
- Judging Guide explaining 1, 3 and 5 points, tie breakers and a sample scored card
- Results Tally Sheet for up to three judges
- People's Choice Ballots, 8 per page
- 12 award categories, from Grand Champion to Pretzel Architect
- Certificates for the Kids, Teen and Adult divisions plus People's Choice and a Special Award

Great for family Christmas parties, classrooms, church groups and office holiday parties.

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home or at a print shop. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". For personal use.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
